prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Don't worry, you can customize your pet's path and appearance anytime in settings after adoption."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop screen while you work."]
2: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile", "Signing in ensures your adopted pet data and progress stay safely backed up in the cloud.", "Use your main account to prevent pet profile resets."]
3: ["Connecting securely to pet authentication servers..."]
4: []
5: ["Custom Pet Photo Tips", "Follow these quick tips for the best custom pet results.", "Use high resolution images with clear subject lighting"]
6: ["Select Your Desktop Friend", "Choose a pet companion to join your desktop environment."]
7: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Environment", "Preparing screen overlays and pet assets for launch."]
8: ["Desktop Pet Controls Overview", "Quick guide on how to interact with, move, or hide your pet on screen.", "Click pet to interact | Right click desktop icon for options"]
9: ["Your Desktop Pet is Active!", "Your new pet is now roaming your screen. Left click your pet to interact, or right click the system tray icon for menu options.", "You can move or hide your pet anytime from the tray menu."]
